effects: Pulls `amount` GROVE (collateral 0xB30F…9406) from the signer into the vault via safeTransferFrom.
Mints vault shares (stGROVE) to `onBehalfOf`, which can be another address than the signer. The share count is computed from the vault's active stake and shares.
formats.shown: Deposit 123.25 GROVE into the vault, with the shares credited to the beneficiary address shown.

findings.title: deposit: the number of stGROVE shares minted to onBehalfOf is not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_)`. The count comes from storage and is not in the calldata. The descriptor shows only `#.amount` and `#.onBehalfOf`.
findings.fix: None possible. The beneficiary and amount are already shown.

effects: Burns the signer's active stGROVE shares, the amount needed to cover `amount` GROVE (rounded up).
Queues `amount` GROVE for the next epoch. The right to claim it goes to `claimer`, who can be another address than the signer.
The queued assets can still be slashed until the epoch ends. Nothing is paid out in this call.
formats.shown: Request a 2.5 GROVE withdrawal from the vault, claimable by the 'Claim owner' address.

findings.title: withdraw: the stGROVE burned from the signer is computed on-chain and not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake())`. _withdraw then pushes `activeSharesOf(msg.sender) - burnedShares`. The share count comes from storage.
findings.fix: None needed. The asset amount shown sets the burn.

findings.title: withdraw: the intent does not say the funds arrive only after the epoch ends and are slashable until then.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _withdraw: `uint256 epoch = currentEpoch() + 1; withdrawals[epoch] = ...`. onSlash reduces `withdrawals[currentEpoch_ + 1]`. The intent reads 'Request withdrawal'.
findings.fix: Optionally say 'Request withdrawal (claimable after the current epoch)'.

effects: Burns `shares` stGROVE from the signer's active balance.
Queues the GROVE equivalent of those shares for the next epoch, claimable by `claimer`, which can be another address than the signer. The queued GROVE can be slashed until the epoch ends.
formats.shown: Queue 0.987654321123456789 stGROVE for withdrawal, with the 'Claim owner' address shown.

findings.title: redeem: the GROVE amount queued for the claimer is computed on-chain and not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: `withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares())`. The rate comes from storage and is not in the calldata.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for `epoch` as claimed.
Transfers the GROVE the signer is owed for that epoch from the vault to `recipient`, which can be another address than the signer.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawal of epoch 42 to the recipient address. No amount and no token are named.

findings.title: claim: the GROVE amount sent to the recipient comes from storage and is not shown.
findings.fix: None possible. The intent could name the token, e.g. 'Claim GROVE withdrawal'.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawals for every listed epoch as claimed.
Transfers the sum of the GROVE owed for those epochs from the vault to `recipient`, which can be another address than the signer.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawals of the listed epochs to the recipient address. Every epoch is shown; no amount and no token are named.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total GROVE sent to the recipient comes from storage and is not shown.
findings.fix: None possible. The intent could name the token, e.g. 'Claim GROVE withdrawals'.
